C++ tensilelite-client reference CSV — generation instructions
=============================================================

Binary: build_tmp/tensilelite/client/tensilelite-client

The C++ client requires a pre-built solution library for each problem combination.
A full Tensile 3-phase pipeline run is needed before the client can benchmark anything:
  1. BenchmarkProblems  (generates kernels)
  2. LibraryLogic       (selects best solution per size)
  3. ClientWriter       (wraps kernels into a runtime-loadable library)

Without these artifacts, the C++ client exits with:
  "vector::_M_range_check: __n (which is 1) >= this->size() (which is 1)"
(library is empty / no solutions found for the requested problem type).

--- COMMANDS (to run when a library is available) ---

# fp32 NT batched — gemm_standard.yaml group 0
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib ./tensilelite-client \
  --library-file <lib_dir>/TensileLibrary.yaml \
  --code-object  <lib_dir>/TensileLibrary_gfx950.co \
  --type Float \
  --problem-identifier 'Contraction_l_Alik_Bjlk_Cijk_Dijk' \
  --strided-batched \
  --problem-size 256,256,4,256 \
  --problem-size 512,512,4,512 \
  --problem-size 1024,1024,4,1024 \
  --num-warmups 3 --num-benchmarks 10 \
  --results-file cpp_client_fp32.csv

# bf16 NT batched — gemm_standard.yaml group 2
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib ./tensilelite-client \
  --library-file <lib_dir>/TensileLibrary.yaml \
  --code-object  <lib_dir>/TensileLibrary_gfx950.co \
  --a-type BFloat16 --b-type BFloat16 --c-type BFloat16 --d-type BFloat16 \
  --compute-input-type-A Float --compute-input-type-B Float \
  --high-precision-accumulate \
  --problem-identifier 'Contraction_l_Alik_Bjlk_Cijk_Dijk' \
  --strided-batched \
  --problem-size 256,256,4,256 \
  --problem-size 512,512,4,512 \
  --problem-size 1024,1024,4,1024 \
  --problem-size 2048,2048,4,2048 \
  --problem-size 4096,4096,4,4096 \
  --num-warmups 3 --num-benchmarks 10 \
  --results-file cpp_client_bf16.csv

# int8 in / int32 out — gemm_int_xf32.yaml group 0
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib ./tensilelite-client \
  --a-type Int8 --b-type Int8 --c-type Int32 --d-type Int32 \
  --high-precision-accumulate \
  --problem-identifier 'Contraction_l_Alik_Bjlk_Cijk_Dijk' \
  --strided-batched \
  --problem-size 256,256,4,256 \
  --problem-size 512,512,4,512 \
  --num-warmups 3 --num-benchmarks 10 \
  --results-file cpp_client_int8.csv

# fp8 E4M3 OCP — gemm_fp8.yaml group 0
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib ./tensilelite-client \
  --a-type Float8 --b-type Float8 --c-type Float --d-type Float \
  --high-precision-accumulate \
  --problem-identifier 'Contraction_l_Alik_Bjlk_Cijk_Dijk' \
  --strided-batched \
  --problem-size 256,256,4,256 \
  --problem-size 512,512,4,512 \
  --problem-size 1024,1024,4,1024 \
  --num-warmups 3 --num-benchmarks 10 \
  --results-file cpp_client_fp8.csv

# MX float8 + E8 scale — gemm_mx.yaml group 0
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/rocm/lib ./tensilelite-client \
  --a-type Float8 --b-type Float8 --c-type Float --d-type Float \
  --mx-a-type Float8 --mx-b-type Float8 \
  --mx-a-block 32 --mx-b-block 32 \
  --high-precision-accumulate \
  --problem-identifier 'Contraction_l_Alik_Bjlk_Cijk_Dijk' \
  --strided-batched \
  --problem-size 256,256,4,256 \
  --problem-size 512,512,4,512 \
  --num-warmups 3 --num-benchmarks 10 \
  --results-file cpp_client_mx.csv

--- STATUS ---
Blocked at M13 implementation. The environment had only the C++ binary
but no matching pre-built solution libraries for gfx950.
Python SweepRunner parity tests use plausibility ranges [100, 1_000_000 GFLOPS]
instead of comparing against this reference CSV.
